text: The Patriots face the Raiders on Sunday without starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck), joining four other ruled-out players in what shapes up as a significant secondary challenge against Kirk Cousins, who's off to a torrid start this season—though the good news is that running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after his absence. On the bright side, the Patriots' edge rusher trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has exceeded expectations through the first four games, which could help generate pressure on Cousins and mitigate some of the secondary's injury woes. The team will wear throwback uniforms for the Week 5 matchup and will honor Pro Football Hall of Fame inductee Adam Vinatieri during halftime, with the ceremony streaming live on Patriots.com.
